body.x: CORE participated in ‘CES 2018(Consumer Technology Show)’, the world’s largest IT consumer electronics show held in Las Vegas, the U.S.A. from Tues. 9th to Fri. 12th in Jan. and introduced an AIO (All in one) 360-degree live system.

Currently, the core is an algorithmic optimization technology that can reduce the volume of a 360° video by 80%, which is in the process of an accelerating program in Silicon Valley, USA since last November. The official said “Although Korea’s VR market is focused on game field, foreign companies are focusing on the VR technology to be solve currently, based on the experiences of participating in overseas exhibitions such as Web Summit in Portugal and CES.

The 360° LIVE Streaming optimization technology is a solution with ‘time’ and ‘picture quality’ improved, which had been problems when streaming and is a result of focusing on the development of the algorithmic optimization technology. This technology helps to watch a high-definition 360° video 4 times faster by reducing its volume by 80%. The official said “At this CES, we received an enthusiastic response from global automobile companies such as Ford, Toyota, BMW, and Mercedes Benz and we will discuss for proceeding collaboration in the future.

Core has been recognized with its unique technology by overseas buyer and highly evaluated that its extensibility is high. The official said about the future plan, “we plan to develop an image edit technology which can reduce time by 20% compared to existing model as well as our own 360° Live Streaming optimization service” and “we will preempt the technology through our own technology in the VR contents market, which can be used in many fields.”

On the other hand, CES, the largest IT exhibition in the world, is held every January as sponsored by the American Consumer Technology Association (CTA), an exhibition to be able to understand the trends of the global consumer electronics industry at one sight. Aving News, which has the most reported issues of CES, MWC, and IFA, the world’s top three tech exhibition for the last 11 years, dispatches special news reporters to CES this year as well, report major issues in the world market and introduces Korea’s major companies all over the world.
